$comment: Seed training dataset for the assistant, slice 1: general help only (how to use HMS). No patient data anywhere: not in patterns, responses or tests. Format per intent: tag, patterns (example user messages, Indonesian and English), responses (answer text per language), context_set ('' = needs no attached record). 'review' says where the answer comes from: 'from_app' = written from what the HMS web app shows today (owner to confirm the wording), 'needs_owner' = the hospital must supply the facts. 'test' is a held-out set: never train on it; use it to measure level 1 before a release. Not active until approved by the owner or an IAM administrator; then it is loaded as an assistant knowledge release.

approval.note: Approved in the HMS workspace session of 2026-11-10. help.contact_support stays out of the release until its facts (unit, extension, hours) replace the TODO.

responses.text: Halo! Saya asisten HMS. Saya bisa membantu cara memakai HMS, atau membacakan rekam kunjungan yang Anda tandai.
Hello! I am the HMS assistant. I can help you use HMS, or read back a visit record you tag.
Sama-sama. Ada lagi yang bisa saya bantu?
You're welcome. Anything else I can help with?
Baik. Panel asisten bisa dibuka lagi kapan saja dari jendela mana pun.
All right. You can open the assistant panel again from any window.

patterns: how do I use the assistant

responses.text: Saya bisa: (1) menjelaskan cara memakai HMS, misalnya masuk, membuka modul, atau mengganti bahasa; (2) membacakan rekam kunjungan yang Anda tandai: ringkasan, diagnosis (ICD-10), prosedur (ICD-9-CM), hasil lab yang ditandai, obat, dan kesiapan klaim. Saya tidak memberi saran medis, diagnosis, atau rekomendasi terapi.

I can (1) explain how to use HMS, such as signing in, opening modules or changing the language, and (2) read back a visit you tag: summary, diagnoses (ICD-10), procedures (ICD-9-CM), flagged lab results, medications and claim readiness. I do not give medical advice, diagnoses or treatment recommendations.

patterns: is it the same password as khanza

responses.text: Masuk dengan ID pengguna dan kata sandi Khanza Anda sendiri; HMS tidak punya kata sandi terpisah. Hanya dokter atau pegawai yang aktif di Khanza yang bisa masuk.
Sign in with your own Khanza user ID and password; HMS has no separate password. Only doctors or employees who are active in Khanza can sign in.

Periksa ID pengguna dan kata sandi Khanza Anda; hanya dokter atau pegawai yang aktif yang bisa masuk. Setelah terlalu banyak percobaan gagal, tunggu beberapa menit lalu coba lagi. Jika akun HMS Anda ditangguhkan atau masalah berlanjut, hubungi IT.

Check your Khanza user ID and password; only active doctors or employees can sign in. After too many failed attempts, wait a few minutes and try again. If your HMS account is suspended or the problem continues, contact IT.

patterns: baru pertama login tidak bisa apa-apa
how do I get a role

responses.text: Akses di HMS diberikan lewat peran. Saat pertama kali masuk, akun Anda belum punya peran, jadi belum bisa melakukan apa pun. Minta administrator IAM rumah sakit memberi peran yang sesuai tugas Anda.
Access in HMS comes from roles. When you first sign in, your account has no role yet, so it cannot do anything. Ask the hospital's IAM administrator to grant the role that fits your work.

patterns: how long does the session last

responses.text: Demi keamanan data pasien, sesi berakhir jika tidak aktif beberapa saat atau jika tab ditutup, dan semua jendela yang terbuka ikut ditutup. Sebelum berakhir muncul peringatan 'Sesi akan berakhir'; pilih 'Tetap masuk' untuk melanjutkan. Setelah berakhir, masuk lagi.

To protect patient data, the session ends after a period without activity or when the tab is closed, and all open windows close with it. Before it ends, a 'Your session is about to end' warning appears; choose 'Stay signed in' to continue. After it ends, sign in again.

patterns: how do I open a module

responses.text: Buka modul dari 'Peluncur modul' di bilah atas, atau tombol 'Buka modul' di dok bawah. Setiap modul terbuka sebagai jendela, dan jendela yang terbuka tampil di dok bawah ('Jendela terbuka') untuk berpindah.

Open a module from the module launcher in the top bar, or the 'Open module' button in the bottom dock. Each module opens as a window, and open windows are listed in the bottom dock so you can switch between them.
Pilih 'Bahasa' di bilah atas untuk berganti antara Bahasa Indonesia dan English.
Choose 'Language' in the top bar to switch between Bahasa Indonesia and English.

patterns: how do I tag a visit
how does the assistant know the patient

responses.text: Tandai kunjungan dengan 'Tanya asisten' di jendela kunjungan, atau cari no. rawat di panel asisten. Kunjungan yang ditandai tampil sebagai chip; hapus dengan tombol di chip. Jika beberapa kunjungan ditandai, pilih chip yang dimaksud. Saya tidak pernah memilihkan kunjungan atau memakai jendela yang sedang terbuka sebagai konteks.

Tag a visit with 'Ask assistant' in its window, or search its encounter number in the assistant panel. Tagged visits show as chips; remove one with its button. If several visits are tagged, pick the chip you mean. I never choose a visit for you or use the window you have open as context.

patterns: apa yang bisa ditanyakan tentang kunjungan
what can I ask about a visit

responses.text: Setelah menandai kunjungan, tanyakan: ringkasan, diagnosis (ICD-10), prosedur (ICD-9-CM), hasil lab yang ditandai lab, obat, atau kesiapan klaim. Setiap jawaban menyebut sumbernya dan hanya berisi apa yang tercatat, bukan saran medis.

After tagging a visit, ask for its summary, diagnoses (ICD-10), procedures (ICD-9-CM), lab results flagged by the lab, medications or claim readiness. Every answer names its source and only shows what is recorded; it is not medical advice.

patterns: checklist klaim lengkap berarti diterima bpjs?
does a complete checklist mean the claim is accepted

responses.text: Kesiapan klaim adalah pemeriksaan internal yang dijalankan server atas data kunjungan BPJS (SEP) yang tercatat. Daftar periksa yang lengkap berarti siap diajukan menurut aturan internal, bukan jaminan klaim diterima BPJS atau penjamin lain.

Claim readiness is an internal check the server runs on the visit's recorded BPJS data (SEP). A complete checklist means ready to submit under the internal rules; it does not guarantee that BPJS or another payer accepts the claim.

Saya tidak dapat memberi saran medis, diagnosis, atau rekomendasi terapi. Keputusan klinis ada pada dokter yang merawat. Saya dapat menampilkan isi rekam kunjungan yang ditandai.
I cannot give medical advice, diagnoses or treatment recommendations. Clinical decisions belong to the treating doctor. I can show what is recorded in a tagged visit.
Maaf, saya hanya membantu pemakaian HMS dan membacakan rekam kunjungan yang ditandai.
Sorry, I only help with using HMS and reading back tagged visit records.
